# Enumeration and Dataset Creation

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Create Dataset

Create a project-linked dataset of SMILES and associated bioactivity or assay measurements, organized by target gene, assay type and measurement endpoint. Saved datasets provide the required training data for the platform's Custom Property Model regression and classification workflows.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#create-dataset)

Exact job name: `dataset_creation`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrap_id` | string | yes | value | Gene or protein name entered in the current product UI; the UI serializes this value under the historical wire key `scrap_id`. |
| `data_type` | string | yes | value | Bioactivity endpoint selected in the current product UI. |
| `assay_type` | string | yes | value | Assay context selected in the current product UI. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "scrap_id": {
      "description": "Gene or protein name entered in the current product UI; the UI serializes this value under the historical wire key `scrap_id`.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "data_type": {
      "description": "Bioactivity endpoint selected in the current product UI.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "IC50",
        "EC50",
        "Ki"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "assay_type": {
      "description": "Assay context selected in the current product UI.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "Cell free",
        "Cell based",
        "Both"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "scrap_id",
    "data_type",
    "assay_type"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "dataset_creation",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "scrap_id": "<user value; see scrap_id schema>",
    "data_type": "<user value; see data_type schema>",
    "assay_type": "<user value; see assay_type schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### Results

Accepted is not completed. Poll the returned job ID without resubmitting.
Preserve every returned artifact link; download and inspect requested outputs before reporting success.
Report actual service errors and incomplete outputs. Refresh status for expired links.

## R-Group Enumeration

R-Group Enumeration

Exact job name: `Molecule_Enumeration`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `building_blocks_file` | string | yes | file | Uploaded fragments CSV. |
| `input_scaffolds_file` | string | yes | value | Scaffold containing R-group placeholders such as `[R1]` and `[R2]`; the live submission accepted a literal scaffold, not a file path. |
| `global_models` | array | yes | value | Property model names as strings; the live submission used `CaCo2 permeability`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema
